scenes.title: The Nodal Early Exercise Rule: Intrinsic vs Continuation Value
scenes.purpose: At every intermediate node, compare intrinsic payoff (S - K for calls, K - S for puts) against continuation value
takeaways: At every intermediate node, compare intrinsic payoff (S - K for calls, K - S for puts) against continuation value
Continuation value is discounted risk-neutral expectation: exp(-r * dt) * [p * f_u + (1 - p) * f_d]
If intrinsic payoff exceeds continuation value, early exercise is optimal and sets the nodal value

beats.speaker: mentor

en.display: Let us examine the core algorithmic decision rule executed at every single node during backward induction.

hi.display: Aaiye American option ke core algorithmic decision rule ko samajhte hain jo backward induction ke har single node par execute hota hai.

beats.onScreenIntent: Formulate the universal nodal decision rule for American options

beats.speaker: mentor

en.display: At any intermediate node, the holder has two choices: First, exercise immediately to claim cash intrinsic value.

hi.display: Tree ke kisi bhi intermediate node par holder ke paas do options hote hain: Pehla, option ko immediately exercise karke cash intrinsic value claim karna.

beats.onScreenIntent: Show how continuation value is calculated from future child nodes

beats.speaker: mentor

en.display: Second, hold the option for continuation value: The discounted risk-neutral expectation of successor nodes.

hi.display: Doosra, option ko hold karna jisse continuation value milti hai: jo successor nodes ka discounted risk-neutral expectation hoti hai.

beats.onScreenIntent: Explain when early exercise triggers: intrinsic > continuation

beats.speaker: mentor

en.display: A rational investor chooses whichever value is greater: f_node = max(Intrinsic Value, Continuation Value)!

hi.display: Rational investor dono mein se jo value badi hogi use choose karta hai: f node equals maximum of Intrinsic Value comma Continuation Value!

beats.onScreenIntent: Summarize: the lattice automatically traces out the optimal early exercise boundary

scenes.title: American Calls on Non-Dividend Stocks: Why Early Exercise Is Suboptimal
scenes.purpose: Exercising an American call early forfeits the remaining time value of the option
takeaways: Exercising an American call early forfeits the remaining time value of the option
Delaying payment of cash strike K earns risk-free interest, and provides downside stock protection
On trees without dividends, American call continuation value strictly exceeds intrinsic value at every node

beats.speaker: mentor

en.display: Now we examine a foundational theorem: American calls on non-dividend stocks should NEVER be exercised early!

hi.display: Ab aate hain quantitative finance ke ek bohot powerful theorem par: Non-dividend paying stocks par American Call option ko kabhi bhi early exercise nahi karna chahiye!

beats.onScreenIntent: State the famous financial theorem: never exercise American calls early without dividends

beats.speaker: mentor

en.display: At every node on a binomial tree, calculation proves that continuation value strictly exceeds intrinsic value S - K.

hi.display: Binomial tree ke har single node par calculation ye prove karti hai ki Call option ki continuation value hamesha intrinsic value S minus K se strictly badi hoti hai.

beats.onScreenIntent: Explain interest advantage: keep cash strike K invested earning risk-free rate r

beats.speaker: mentor

en.display: Exercising early pays strike K prematurely, forfeiting interest while destroying downside crash insurance.

hi.display: Agar aap call early exercise karte hain, toh aap strike K premature pay kar dete hain jisse interest lose hota hai, aur sath hi crash protection insurance bhi destroy ho jati hai.

beats.onScreenIntent: Demonstrate downside insurance protection retained by keeping the call alive

beats.speaker: mentor

en.display: Therefore, on non-dividend stocks, American call and European call prices are strictly identical: C = c!

hi.display: Isliye non-dividend stocks par American Call aur European Call ki theoretical price identical hoti hai: C equals c!

beats.onScreenIntent: Verify on binomial lattice: C equals c at every node, confirming equivalence

scenes.title: Dynamic Delta Hedging on Trees: Rebalancing Across Space and Time
scenes.purpose: Delta is calculated locally at every tree node: delta = (f_u - f_d) / (S_u - S_d)
takeaways: Delta is calculated locally at every tree node: delta = (f_u - f_d) / (S_u - S_d)
Because delta changes as stock price moves (gamma), the hedge must be continuously rebalanced
Discrete binomial hedging converges to continuous delta-neutral hedging in the diffusion limit

beats.speaker: mentor

en.display: Binomial trees not only price options, but provide market makers an exact dynamic hedging roadmap.

hi.display: Binomial tree na sirf options ko price karti hai, balki market makers ko exact dynamic hedging roadmap bhi provide karti hai.

beats.onScreenIntent: Demonstrate that delta is not static across tree nodes

beats.speaker: mentor

en.display: Notice that Delta is not constant: Δ0 at the root differs from Δu at the up-node and Δd at the down-node.

hi.display: Notice kijiye ki Delta constant nahi rehta: Root node par Delta zero alag hota hai, upper node par Delta u alag hota hai, aur lower node par Delta d alag hota hai.

beats.onScreenIntent: Calculate delta at up node and down node, revealing curvature (gamma)

beats.speaker: mentor

en.display: If the stock rallies, call Delta expands, forcing the market maker to buy additional shares.

hi.display: Agar stock upar move karta hai toh call ka Delta badh jata hai, jisse market maker ko market se aur shares buy karne padte hain.

beats.onScreenIntent: Explain why trading desks must execute rebalancing trades at every step

beats.speaker: mentor

en.display: If the stock falls, Delta contracts and shares are sold. This node-by-node rebalancing is Dynamic Delta Hedging!

hi.display: Agar stock girta hai toh Delta drop ho jata hai aur shares sell karne padte hain. Is node-by-node share adjustment ko Dynamic Delta Hedging kehte hain!

beats.onScreenIntent: Connect discrete lattice rehedging to continuous Black-Scholes dynamic hedging

scenes.title: Cox-Ross-Rubinstein (CRR) Volatility Calibration
scenes.purpose: To match continuous lognormal diffusion, tree parameters u and d must match variance sigma^2 * dt
takeaways: To match continuous lognormal diffusion, tree parameters u and d must match variance sigma^2 * dt
Cox, Ross, and Rubinstein set u = exp(sigma * sqrt(dt)) and d = 1 / u = exp(-sigma * sqrt(dt))
Symmetric geometry ensures recombining condition u * d = 1 holds perfectly, anchoring center nodes

beats.speaker: mentor

en.display: In practice, u and d are not arbitrary numbers; they are mathematically calibrated to observable market volatility σ.

hi.display: Real world options trading mein up factor u aur down factor d arbitary numbers nahi hote; unhe market ki observable Volatility sigma se mathematically calibrate kiya jata hai.

beats.onScreenIntent: Pose the calibration challenge: how to choose u and d to match real-world volatility

beats.speaker: mentor

en.display: In 1979, Cox, Ross, and Rubinstein derived the CRR formulas: u = e^(σ*sqrt(Δt)) and d = 1/u.

hi.display: Nineteen seventy-nine mein Cox, Ross aur Rubinstein ne CRR formula invent kiya: u equals e to the power sigma square root delta t, aur d equals one divided by u.

beats.onScreenIntent: Present the Cox-Ross-Rubinstein parameterization: u = exp(sigma * sqrt(dt))

beats.speaker: mentor

en.display: This calibration ensures the discrete binomial distribution matches the exact variance of Geometric Brownian Motion.

hi.display: Ye calibration prove karti hai ki discrete binomial distribution continuous Geometric Brownian Motion ke variance ko penny-for-penny match karti hai.

beats.onScreenIntent: Show why d = 1/u creates symmetric recombining lattices

beats.speaker: mentor

en.display: And probability p becomes (a - d) / (u - d), where a = e^(r*Δt) represents the risk-free growth factor!

hi.display: Aur probability formula p equals a minus d divided by u minus d ban jata hai, jahan a equals e to the power r delta t growth factor hai!

beats.onScreenIntent: Explain how higher volatility sigma widens the tree branching cone

scenes.title: Multi-Asset Lattice Generalization: Parameter a
scenes.purpose: Parameter a represents the risk-neutral expected growth factor: a = exp((r - q) * dt)
takeaways: Parameter a represents the risk-neutral expected growth factor: a = exp((r - q) * dt)
For non-dividend stock: q = 0 -> a = exp(r * dt)
For dividend stock q > 0; for currency options q = r_f; for futures options q = r (a = 1)

beats.speaker: mentor

en.display: In Section 13.9, John Hull demonstrates the binomial model's universal elegance: Multi-Asset Generalization.

hi.display: John Hull Section thirteen point nine mein binomial model ki sabse elegant universal property demonstrate karte hain: Multi-Asset Generalization.

beats.onScreenIntent: Introduce parameter a as the unified risk-neutral drift factor

beats.speaker: mentor

en.display: You never need separate tree code for different assets; simply adjust the single growth parameter a.

hi.display: Aapko alag-alag assets ke liye naya tree code likhne ki bilkul zaroorat nahi hoti; sirf single parameter a ko adjust karna hota hai.

beats.onScreenIntent: Apply parameter a to continuous dividend yields: a = exp((r - q)*dt)

beats.speaker: mentor

en.display: For dividend stocks and indices, a = e^((r - q)Δt), where q is continuous dividend yield.

hi.display: Dividend-paying stocks aur stock indices ke liye a equals e to the power r minus q delta t ban jata hai, jahan q continuous dividend yield hai.

beats.onScreenIntent: Extend to FX options: replace q with foreign interest rate r_f

beats.speaker: mentor

en.display: For foreign currencies, a = e^((r - rf)Δt), and for Commodity Futures, a becomes simply exactly 1.0!

hi.display: Foreign currencies ke liye a equals e to the power r minus r f delta t hota hai, aur Commodity Futures ke liye a simply exactly one ban jata hai!

beats.onScreenIntent: Extend to futures contracts: set a = 1 since futures earn zero cost-of-carry

scenes.title: Active Recall Scenario: American Put Early Exercise Decision
scenes.purpose: Early exercise is optimal if and only if Intrinsic Value > Continuation Value
takeaways: Early exercise is optimal if and only if Intrinsic Value > Continuation Value
Intrinsic value for a put is max(K - S, 0); continuation value is discounted expected child payoff
Early exercise captures cash strike immediately, avoiding the loss of interest

beats.speaker: mentor

en.display: Let us test your active recall understanding on a concrete American Put early exercise problem from John Hull.

hi.display: Aaiye ab aapki active recall understanding ko John Hull ke ek concrete American Put early exercise decision problem par test karte hain.

beats.onScreenIntent: Present the numerical challenge: S=$40, K=$50, child payoffs $8 and $12

beats.speaker: mentor

en.display: American Put K = $50. Stock falls to $36. Intrinsic value is $14.00; continuation value is $12.80. What is node value and is early exercise optimal?

hi.display: American Put option ka strike K fifty dollars hai. Tree ke step one down node par stock girkar thirty-six dollars ho chuka hai. Intrinsic exercise payoff fourteen dollars hai, jabki discounted continuation holding value twelve point eight zero dollars hai. Is node par option ki value kya hogi aur kya early exercise optimal hai? Calculate kijiye.

beats.onScreenIntent: Calculate intrinsic value: $50 - $40 = $10.00

beats.speaker: mentor

en.display: The correct answer is Option A: Node value is $14.00 and early exercise is immediately optimal.

hi.display: Sahi answer Option A hai: Node par option value fourteen dollars hogi aur early exercise immediately optimal hai.

beats.onScreenIntent: Calculate discounted continuation value: exp(-0.03) * $10 = $9.704

beats.speaker: mentor

en.display: Apply the rule: Node Value = max($14.00, $12.80). Because $14.00 > $12.80, a rational holder exercises immediately to claim $14 cash!

hi.display: Rule apply kijiye: Node Value equals maximum of Intrinsic Value fourteen dollars comma Continuation Value twelve point eight zero dollars. Kyunki fourteen dollars twelve point eight zero se bada hai, isliye rational holder immediately exercise karke fourteen dollars cash claim karega!

beats.onScreenIntent: Conclude: $10.00 > $9.70 triggers immediate early exercise, unlocking $0.30 surplus

data.question: A stock is at S = $40. Strike K = $50. If child node option values are f_u = $8 and f_d = $12 with p = 0.50, r = 6%, dt = 0.5, should the American put be exercised?
options: The equilibrium condition holds via continuous risk-neutral replication.
Expected asset drift determines contingent claim value directly.
Arbitrage bounds can be systematically violated in liquid markets.
Discrete binomial tree steps eliminate all underlying price variance.
data.explanation: Immediate exercise delivers K - S = $50 - $40 = $10.00. Continuation value is exp(-0.06 * 0.5) * [0.5 * 8 + 0.5 * 12] = exp(-0.03) * 10 = $9.704. Because $10.00 > $9.704, immediate early exercise is optimal!
